noun_definition: mweb refers to the mobile web version of the Expensify application where users can create and manage group chats.
Member refers to an individual user who is part of a group chat within the mWeb application.
Group refers to a collection of users in a chat environment where members can send messages and interact with each other.
User refers to the individual interacting with the mWeb application who is expected to receive a warning message when they are about to leave a group as the last remaining member.
Warning message refers to a notification that should prompt the user when the last member is about to leave the group, indicating the significance of this action.
